Specification: This module is a very small auxiliary TLA+ specification that defines a single helper operator. It extends the Integers module but does not model a transition system, declare variables, or state any temporal properties. Its notable feature is a LET expression containing a typed comment and a record constructor, while the operator ultimately evaluates to the string literal "X".
